goal: Generate v3 policy code and generated tests from vocabulary and policy YAML.
when_to_use: Use after editing v3 policy-vocabulary.yaml or policy-rules.yaml.
commands: go run ./cmd/cervorules-policygen generate -vocab policy-vocabulary.yaml -policy policy-rules.yaml -out internal/policyrules/generated_policy.go -test-out internal/policyrules/generated_policy_test.go -package policyrules -vocab-package policyvocab -vocab-import your/module/internal/policyvocab
failure_mode: Fail the task if generation changes files unexpectedly or generated tests do not compile.
notes: Run validate-policy before generation when changing YAML by hand.
